Cancel before renewal to stop the next invoice. For {{plans.improve.public_name}} and {{plans.grow.public_name}}, we choose useful work and confirm the needed information five business days before the next month. If nothing is ready, the next improvement invoice pauses; included care is agreed in writing, with no automatic replacement charge. copy_templates.monthly_terms.rollover: An unused set of supplied edits does not carry over. If I fall behind on work you have approved, I still owe it to you; we agree on a new date or refund. copy_templates.monthly_terms.pause: If an {{plans.improve.public_name}} or {{plans.grow.public_name}} month pauses, I agree with you in writing whether its basic care continues. I do not automatically charge for a different plan. I still finish work you have already paid for, or agree on a refund.
